The spread set, 2026-11-13

Eight more kinds of relational tech: four remixes of gallery items, worded the way the Builder's gallery opens a remix, and four new asks. Each column is a model, with the Builder's current design guidance and two fix passes. A column marked "+ library" also saw one reference screen of a different app from the Builder's library (for now, screens from Opus builds); other open-model columns had no Opus help. A green edge means the app works; a red one means it bundled with errors or didn't bundle.
